name: pw-trainer
description: Playwright Practice Shop — учебный интернет-магазин для тренировки автотестов на Playwright

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start:e2e: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000 node --import tsx server/src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w tests
